description:
All-in-one ebook reader

Koodo Reader is an all-in-one eBook reader for Windows, macOS, Linux, and the web, supporting over 15 formats.
New Features
- Reading statistics now support filtering by book and time range
- Support for creating notes in Markdown and HTML formats
- A reading duration leaderboard has been added to reading statistics
- The TTS plugin now supports naturalVoiceSapiAdapter; you can now use the local Microsoft neural network speech package for TTS
- Added a local dictionary aggregation feature that aggregates and displays search results from locally imported dictionaries
- Local dictionaries now support more formats, including: StarDict / DICT / Slob / BGL
- Auto-read, Speed Reading mode, Reading Ruler, and Paragraph mode can now be configured per book
- Expanded the adjustable range for auto-read scrolling speed
- Support for deleting individual books from the Recycle Bin
- Support for rendering from even pages in two-page mode for formats such as comics
- Automatically switches to single-page mode when the reading window width is less than 900px
- ESC shortcut key support added for the dictionary, translation, Ask AI, and notes popups
- Added simulated book cover feature; go to Settings > Appearance to enable it
- Added current chapter word count and remaining battery level to the footer
- Added text highlighting; enable it in “Reading Aids” in the top-right corner
- AI chat now automatically jumps to the latest position
- The doodling feature now supports dashed lines
- Optimized rendering performance for DJVU format
- (Mobile) Supports importing and exporting local notes, highlights, and lookup history
- (Mobile) Supports importing book packages in KDZ format exported from the desktop version
- (Mobile) Support for turning pages using a Bluetooth keyboard
- (Mobile) Added support for OCR APIs; go to Settings > API Settings to add them
- (Mobile) Added web page translation and web dictionary features, supporting Google Translate, Bing Dictionary, and more; go to Settings > API Settings
- (Mobile) Added display of the current chapter’s word count in the header
- (Mobile) The Bookshelf now supports importing local books; tap the three-dot button at the top
- (Mobile) Auto-read, Speed Reading mode, Reading Ruler, and Paragraph mode can now be configured per book
- (Mobile) Reading statistics now support filtering by book and time range
- (Mobile) Support for creating notes in Markdown and HTML formats
- (Mobile) Reading statistics now include a reading duration leaderboard
- (Mobile) Added text highlighting functionality
- (Mobile) AI chat now automatically jumps to the latest position
- (Mobile) Optimized rendering performance for DJVU format
Fixes
- Fixed an issue where page turning via the trackpad was too fast
- Fixed an issue where the simulated page-turning animation was missing
- Fixed an issue where images did not display in some EPUB books
- Fixed an issue where right-to-left page turning did not work in portrait orientation
- Fixed an issue where some PDF books were not displayed fully in scroll mode
- Fixed navigation issues in some TXT books
- Fixed UI anomalies in List View and Cover View under certain conditions
- Fixed an issue where double-clicking a book in the file manager did not open it
- Fixed an issue where the app would freeze after looking up words in certain MDX dictionaries
- Fixed an issue where text was not highlighted while listening to audiobooks after applying replacement or deletion rules
- (Mobile) Fixed an issue where book progress was not updated in real time
- (Mobile) Fixed an issue where background images could not be unset
- (Mobile) Fixed an issue where the number of books displayed on the bookshelf did not match the actual count
- (Mobile) Fixed an issue where book collections could not be hidden from the home screen
- (Mobile) Fixed an issue with page number display in two-page mode
- (Mobile) Fixed an issue with page number display in the table of contents of the native PDF reader and comic reader
Tip
You can also download the installation package for this version from the our self-hosted mirror.
